item.title: Team news: Stags v Reading
item.description: Nigel Clough makes three changes to the side that narrowly lost to Arsenal at the weekend. Kyle Knoyle, Tyler Roberts and Rhys Oates are replaced by Elliott Hewitt, Will Evans and Victor Adeboyejo in the XI to face Reading tonight. Louis Reed captains Stags at One Call Stadium. Starting XI: Roberts, Hewitt, Oshilaja, Blake-Tracy, Akins, Reed ©️, Abbott, McLaughlin, Russell, Evans, Adeboyejo. Subs: Bowery, A. Lewis, Moriah-Welsh, Hendry, Irow, Gardner, Oates.

item.title: Report: Stags 1-0 Reading
item.description: Louis Reed’s second-half strike handed Mansfield Town a well-earned 1-0 victory over play-off chasers Reading at One Call Stadium. The Stags applied heaps of pressure on Reading’s goal in an entertaining first-half but were unable to force their way ahead. The vital moment came with 20 minutes to go as Reed took aim from the edge of the box and his strike was diverted past Royals’ ‘keeper Joel Pereira by a visitors defender.
